hypothesis: The useful early distinction inside an exceptional-volume regime is the causal ordering of level escalation, per-book transport alignment, volume-flow acceleration, joint price-speed crest, and explicit authority handoff. Volume magnitude is attention; full CL/MCL alignment owns direction; a crest confirmed before transport is stale impulse, while authority followed by a later crest and renewed alignment is a continuation candidate.

pre_outcome_boundary.decision: Freeze the geometry before the first eligible Stage-114 episode. Any episode whose attention began before the eligible start is excluded even if it ends later.

architecture.state_owner: Stage 114 remains the sole authority-wave state owner.
architecture.derivation: Join only complete immutable Stage-114 episode IDs to their existing source record IDs and finalized bar-prefix identities. Re-read the canonical raw tape; do not create another recorder, timer, runtime owner, or treatment ledger.
architecture.identity: One treatment is one complete Stage-114 episode whose started_at_utc is at or after eligible_episode_start_utc. One derived subunit is one Stage-114 authority wave within that episode.
architecture.pre_bind_direction: Directionless. Preserve raw CL and MCL signs and per-book alignment states; never sign pre-bind evidence with an eventual authority direction.
architecture.post_bind_direction: Only the contemporaneous Stage-114 authority direction may sign evidence from the bind timestamp forward. A handoff starts a new wave and a new signing boundary.
architecture.missingness: Retain missing, zero, mixed, stale-top, spread-ineligible, and unresolved evidence categorically. Never drop an episode to improve a shape.

frozen_levels.source: Unchanged Stage-114 levels; no adjacent magnitude sweep.

exact_geometry_law.clock: IBKR TCP packet receipt UTC for seconds evidence; finalized broker close UTC for completed-minute and slower evidence. Do not infer exchange sequencing.
exact_geometry_law.level_first_passage: For each frozen level, retain the first causal observation at or above the level and exact elapsed seconds from attention. Missing levels remain null.
exact_geometry_law.level_latency: Retain exact elapsed seconds for 5x-to-10x, 10x-to-12x, and 12x-to-20x. Do not bin, clip, rank, or optimize latency.
exact_geometry_law.per_book_alignment: For each book and observation, classify ALIGNED_UP or ALIGNED_DOWN only when its 5s, 15s, 60s, 15m velocity, 15m acceleration, and signed 15s flow are all nonzero and share one sign; otherwise MIXED_OR_ZERO.
exact_geometry_law.transport_order: Within the frozen Stage-89 interval widths around each anchor, retain CL_LEADS, SAME_INTERVAL, MCL_LEADS, CONFLICT, or UNRESOLVED from the first per-book alignment. No future authority direction participates.
exact_geometry_law.volume_flow_jerk: For CL and MCL separately, current volume_velocity_5s minus the immediately preceding valid observation's volume_velocity_5s inside the same receipt-time minute; a minute boundary is unresolved, never a zero continuation.
exact_geometry_law.joint_price_speed: After authority binds, the minimum of contemporaneous authority-signed CL and MCL 5s velocity when both are positive; otherwise unresolved.
exact_geometry_law.joint_price_speed_peak: Between bind and causal crest confirmation, use the earliest maximum joint_price_speed. The peak becomes known only when the unchanged Stage-113 three-lower-observation and three-second crest law confirms it.
exact_geometry_law.volume_flow_crest: Record the earliest running CL/MCL volume-flow peak that is followed by at least three strictly lower valid observations spanning at least three seconds, reusing the inner crest persistence rather than adding a tuned clock.
exact_geometry_law.crest_order: Retain exact ordering and latency among authority bind, volume-flow crest, joint-price-speed peak, and causal price crest. Ties remain ties.
exact_geometry_law.handoff: Use only Stage-114 AUTHORITY_HANDOFF. Reset all geometry at the new wave boundary; never merge opposite waves into one sequence.
exact_geometry_law.cross_scale: At existing Stage-114 transitions retain the already-causal completed 15m evidence, rolling 240m slope/TR state, 30m MCL-minus-CL basis velocity, prior five-session context, and available four-hour news state as non-scoring context. Missing clocks stay missing.

categorical_hypotheses.ORDERED_AUTHORITY_IGNITION: A frozen level escalates, CL aligns no later than MCL, joint alignment binds at 10x or higher, and the joint price-speed crest occurs after binding.
categorical_hypotheses.LEVEL_WITHOUT_TRANSPORT: A 10x-or-higher level is reached without a fresh full CL/MCL bind before the level retreats or the episode terminates.
categorical_hypotheses.CREST_BEFORE_AUTHORITY: Fast price or volume-flow acceleration causally crests before any eligible authority bind; classify as stale impulse, never as automatic reversal.
categorical_hypotheses.POST_BIND_REACCELERATION: Authority binds, a causal joint-speed crest forms, and the unchanged Stage-114 continuation transition later reappears in the same direction.
categorical_hypotheses.ORDERED_HIGHER_LEVEL_HANDOFF: A strictly higher frozen level plus opposite fresh full alignment emits the exact Stage-114 handoff and resets the wave geometry.
categorical_hypotheses.MAX_LEVEL_OPPOSITION_CONTROL: After incumbent authority already owns the 20x regime, opposite fresh full alignment occurs without a strictly higher level. Preserve as a negative control; it cannot modify Stage 114 or imply reversal authority.
categorical_hypotheses.FLOW_PRICE_DECOUPLING: Frozen volume level or positive volume-flow jerk persists while joint price speed is mixed, unresolved, or contracting; preserve the topology without selecting an action.

count_gate.complete_episode_inclusion: Every eligible Stage-114 episode must be present; unresolved fields are categorical evidence, not exclusions.

future_action_boundary.current: Freeze and later derive morphology only after complete Stage-114 episodes exist; do not run outcomes, controls, rankings, scores, or economic settlement.
future_action_boundary.after_count_pass: Preregister matched ordinary-volume and same-level-opposition controls plus sealed economic settlement before testing any timing, chase, hold, release, or handoff action.
